newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa golds shares end firm on stronger bullion.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa golds shares end firm on stronger bullion.

text.p: South African shares ended mixed with golds rising on a better bullion price and industrials steady amid profit-taking.
Dealers said gold, which rose above the $320 level overnight amid shortcovering, was the main driver behind sentiment.
The metal was fixed at $324.20 on Friday afternoon in London, up from the morning fix of $323.45.
Overall volumes traded were hefty again with turnover of 1.13 billion rand boosted by engineering holding firm Invicta which hovered at 580 cents after shares worth 58 million rand changed hands.
Gold shares rose 27.7 points to 992 points, the all-share index lost 12.1 points to 7,424.9 points and industrials were down 3.5 points to 8,937.7 points.
